content.text: Three bugs: the delimiter is `,` instead of `;`, `qty >= 0` should be `> 0`, and the discount is added instead of subtracted.

input.command:
sed -i "s/split(',')/split(';')/" src/pipeline/parse.js
sed -i "s/line.qty >= 0/line.qty > 0/" src/pipeline/validate.js
sed -i "s/return gross + discount/return gross - discount/" src/pipeline/total.js
node --test test/pipeline.test.js 2>&1 | grep -E "^ℹ (pass|fail)"

content.text:
All 5 tests in `test/pipeline.test.js` now pass. There were three bugs in `src/pipeline/`:

1. **`parse.js`**: `parseLine` split on `,`, but the format uses `;`. It now splits on `;`.
2. **`validate.js`**: `isBillable` accepted `qty >= 0`, so zero-quantity lines were kept. It now requires `qty > 0`.
3. **`total.js`**: `total` added the discount to the gross amount instead of subtracting it. It now subtracts it.

I didn't edit the tests or commit anything.
